title: Kuroko settings.toml
description: Settings for Kuroko (%APPDATA%\Kuroko\settings.toml). Mirrors src/Kuroko.Core/Config/SettingsLoader.cs and AppearanceLoader.cs; the app itself reports errors with file and line. General settings must stand above the first [table] line.

overlay_hotkey.description: Global hotkey that opens the overlay.

undo_hotkey.description: Undoes the last replacement (press again to go further back).

undo_history.description: Number of replacements kept in memory (0 = undo off).

result_copy_hotkey.description: Copies the whole text of the result card and closes it. Also copies the finished answer while the error pill of a failed paste is shown. Plain Ctrl+C, Ctrl+A and Ctrl+V are not allowed: the app sends those keys itself when it reads text.

result_position.description: Where the result card appears. fixed: at result_fixed_position. follow: where the prompt picker opens. caret: at the text cursor, otherwise at the mouse. mouse: at the mouse. center is the old name of fixed.

result_fixed_position.description: The fixed place of the result card (result_position = "fixed").

result_screen_margin.description: Distance of the result card to the screen edge in pixels.

result_font_size.description: Font size of the result card text (decimals such as 14.5 are fine).

result_width.description: Width of the result card in pixels (never larger than the monitor).

result_min_height.description: Minimum height of the result card (0 = as small as the text). Must not be larger than result_max_height.

result_max_height.description: Maximum height of the result card; longer text scrolls.

pill_position.description: Where the status pill appears. follow: where the prompt picker opens. caret: at the text cursor, otherwise at the mouse. mouse: at the mouse. fixed: at pill_fixed_position (with pill_screen_margin). card: where the result card appears. For prompts with a result card the pill always sits where the card will appear.

pill_fixed_position.description: The fixed place of the status pill (pill_position = "fixed").

pill_screen_margin.description: Distance of the status pill to the screen edge in pixels, for pill_position fixed, caret and mouse.

pill_min_width.description: Minimum width of the status pill in pixels. Must not be larger than pill_max_width.

pill_max_width.description: Maximum width of the status pill in pixels; longer text wraps.

pill_min_height.description: Minimum height of the status pill (0 = as high as the text). The text is centred; the pill grows when it wraps.

pill_font_size.description: Font size of the status pill.

pill_duration.description: Seconds a note such as "Undone" stays. Errors keep 5 s, the pill after a failed paste 15 s.

marker_start.description: Start of a one-off instruction inside the text (prompts with mode = "universal"). Must not be empty.

marker_end.description: End of a one-off instruction inside the text. Must not be empty.

accent.description: Caret, text selection and progress line colour: none, system or a hex colour like "#3B82F6" (#RGB, #RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB; alpha is ignored).

overlay_position.description: Where the prompt picker opens. fixed: at overlay_fixed_position. center is the old name of fixed.

overlay_fixed_position.description: The fixed place of the prompt picker (overlay_position = "fixed").

overlay_screen_margin.description: Distance of the prompt picker to the screen edge in pixels.

overlay_font_size.description: Font size of the prompt picker; the whole picker scales with it.

overlay_width.description: Width of the prompt picker in pixels (never larger than the monitor).

overlay_min_height.description: Minimum height of the prompt picker (0 = as small as the list). Must not be larger than overlay_max_height.

overlay_max_height.description: Maximum height of the prompt picker; longer lists scroll.

idle_trim_seconds.description: Free unused memory after this many idle seconds (0 = never).

default_provider.description: Provider used when a prompt does not name one. Must exist under [providers.*]. Empty or missing: the first provider.

fallback_provider.description: Provider tried once when a provider cannot be reached (no connection, 5xx, 429). Must exist under [providers.*]. Empty: off. Privacy: the text then goes to this provider. Not used by local providers (only their own fallback_provider applies) and never more than one step. A provider's own fallback_provider wins.

mods.description: Modifier variables: a name for a modifier combination, used in every hotkey as $name (main = "Ctrl" makes "$main+Alt+K" Ctrl+Alt+K). Names: letters, digits and _, not case-sensitive. Values: modifiers only (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win), no key and no other variable. See docs/keybindings.md.

submaps.description: One [submaps.<name>] block per submap: its open hotkey shows the label in the pill and, for timeout milliseconds, makes each listed key a hotkey of its own without modifiers. Names: letters, digits, _ and -. See docs/keybindings.md.

providers.description: One [providers.<name>] block per provider. The name is free and is used by default_provider and by the provider key in prompts.toml.

hotkey.description: Modifiers Ctrl (Control, Strg), Alt, Shift (Umschalt), Win (Windows) joined with + and one key: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F24; a name (Space, Enter, Tab, Esc, Backspace, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Left, Up, Right, Down, Num0-Num9, NumAdd, NumSubtract, NumMultiply, NumDivide, NumDecimal, Oem1-Oem8, Oem102, OemPlus, OemComma, OemMinus, OemPeriod, Plus, PrintScreen, Pause, ScrollLock, CapsLock, NumLock, Menu, media, volume and browser keys); a key code 0x01-0xFE (Ctrl+Alt+0xE2); or the character printed on the key in the active keyboard layout (Ctrl+Alt+ü, Ctrl+Alt+<, Ctrl+Alt++). Only the key's own character counts: characters typed with Shift or AltGr (> | °) are an error. At least one modifier unless the key is F1-F24. A variable from [mods] stands for its modifiers: "$card+S", "$main+Alt+K". See docs/keybindings.md.

spot.description: top-third | center | bottom-third: horizontally centered, in the middle of that third. Corners: top-left | bottom-left | top-right | bottom-right. left | right: at that edge, vertically centered. top | bottom: at that edge, horizontally centered.

appearance.description: Look of the overlay and the result card. A bad value only gives a warning; the default is used for it.

placeholder.description: Grey text in the empty search field of the prompt picker. "" = no placeholder.

selection_style.description: How the selected row is marked: fill (an area) or border (a frame only; the text does not move).

selection_opacity.description: Opacity of the selected row in percent, for both styles. The row under the mouse has half of it.

selection_border_width.description: Width of the frame in px with selection_style = "border".

border.description: Thin border around the window. false means a width of 0, whatever border_width says.

border_width.description: Width of the window border in px.

separator_width.description: Height of the line under the search field in px.

font.default: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI
font.description: Font of the prompt picker, the status pill, the result card and the API key window. Several names separated by commas: the first installed one is used. An unknown name is reported.

custom_corners.description: true: apply the radius exactly on Acrylic/Mica too (needs the Windhawk mod, corners part). false: Windows snaps to 0, 4 or 8 px.

background.description: Window background: #RRGGBB or rgb(r, g, b). Transparency is set by [appearance] transparency.

foreground.description: Main text colour: #RRGGBB or rgb(r, g, b).

selection.description: Selected row: #RRGGBB or rgb(r, g, b). Its opacity is [appearance] selection_opacity; an old value with alpha (#AARRGGBB, rgba()) still works, the alpha is ignored and reported.

border_color.description: Window border: #RRGGBB or rgb(r, g, b). Derived from foreground when missing.

separator_color.description: Line under the search field (also the track of the pill's progress line): #RRGGBB or rgb(r, g, b). Derived from foreground when missing.

open.description: Hotkey that opens the submap; pressed again while it is open, it closes it. Counts in the check for hotkeys used twice.

label.description: Text the pill shows while the submap is open, e.g. which key does what. The submap's name when missing.

timeout.description: Milliseconds the submap stays open without a key. Esc closes it earlier.

keys.description: Key = what it runs. The key is written alone, without modifiers: a letter, digit, F-key, name (Space, Num5), code (0xE2) or the character on the key ("<", "ü"); not Esc. The target is a prompt name from prompts.toml or a command with a slash: /undo, /copy, /prompts, /settings, /folder, /reload, /keys, /test, /autostart, /about, /quit.

type.description: openai-compatible: local servers such as Ollama or LM Studio (no key needed).

base_url.description: Optional, defaults per type. http:// only for local hosts when an API key is configured.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the key.

api_key.description: Key written directly in the file (local only, never commit). Order: api_key, then api_key_env, then the Windows Credential Manager entry "Kuroko:<name>".

fallback_provider.description: Provider tried once when this one cannot be reached (no connection, 5xx, 429). Wins over the global fallback_provider; "" = no fallback for this provider. Must name another provider under [providers.*]. Privacy: the text then goes to that provider.
